finding: Official OS NGD Building guidance states that a Building geometry represents a single building footprint and that separate non-adjoining building parts are represented as Building features. Physical State is created from OS topographic data, aerial imagery and ground survey; Building Use is an attributed field in the Building feature model.
exact_reason: This previously unused official public no-login source window supplies authoritative footprint/type methodology but no concrete Building feature Polygon coordinates and no binding from a concrete OSID/UPRN/TOID to the project's exact canonical_parcel_id. Exact canonical identity plus concrete footprint geometry and record-level field evidence remain missing; accepted_count stays zero.
